title: Presenting ideas
description: Structure and deliver professional presentations with clarity.

introduction.headline: Present with impact
introduction.body: Learn advanced phrases for opening, structuring, and concluding a professional presentation.
introduction.bodyIt: Impara frasi avanzate per aprire, strutturare e concludere una presentazione professionale.
objectives: Open and close a presentation effectively

vocabulary.example: Let me outline the main points.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Permettetemi di delineare i punti principali.

vocabulary.example: She made a compelling case for change.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Ha presentato un caso convincente per il cambiamento.

vocabulary.example: The key takeaway is that we must act now.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Il punto chiave è che dobbiamo agire ora.

exercises.prompt: Which phrase introduces the structure of a talk?
exercises.promptIt: Quale frase introduce la struttura di un intervento?
options: Let me outline the main points.
exercises.answer: Let me outline the main points.
exercises.explanation: Outline signals you will present the structure of your talk.

exercises.prompt: The key ____ from this presentation is clear.
exercises.promptIt: Completa: The key ____ from this presentation is clear.
exercises.explanation: Takeaway refers to the main message the audience should remember.

review.tip: Record a 60-second presentation opening using outline and takeaway.
